Package cbus

Interface Summary
ConnectionListener Interface for subscribing to publisher remote events
InterceptorListener Interface for subscribing to filter events
RemoteEventListener Interface for subscribing to remote events
Session The session class stablishes a simple contract to access publish/subscribe middleware.
 

Class Summary
Context This interface represents a naming context, which consists of a set of name-to-object bindings These constants will be used for connecting to different Notification services.
SessionFactory Facility class that connects to the Notification service using environment params and instantiates the apropriate class provider
 

Exception Summary
SessionException Wrapper Exception class to different Exceptions It simply stores the incoming Exception and provides a method for obtaining the *real* exception.
